highlights: 🔔 Android Active Lock Screen Notification: Upgraded to Active notification category (importance: 3, visibility: 1) with full lock screen visibility, 1-time arrival chime (setOnlyAlertOnce: true), and sticky pinned notification (ongoing: true)
📅 Intuitive Navigation & Dynamic Date Header: Date range title centered directly between navigation arrows with a separate, prominent Today button and live range calculation across all views
🗓️ Multi-Day All-Day Milestone Stream: Dedicated all-day row above timeline reliably displays all-day tasks and daily habits across all visible dates with 1-click completion toggling
⚡ Direct Drag-to-Block Time Scheduler: Draw time blocks directly on empty grid slots with real-time translucent preview and 1-click task backlog assignment
📐 Precision Edge Duration Resizing: Smooth top and bottom drag-resizing with 15-minute snapping, overnight midnight overflow splitting, and suppressed accidental click modals
🛡️ Ghost Lines & Accidental Click Suppression: Suppressed synthesized click events after drag or resize from opening task dialog; eliminated lingering dashed preview boxes on drag drop/cancel
🎨 Inter Normal Universal Default Font: Imported Inter (weights 400, 500, 600, 700) and set it as universal default typeface across the entire app
⚡ Calendar-Day Startup Update Check: Checks for updates once per calendar day on first launch, consuming < 1 KB of data
